content: Indie studio/game marketing sites converge on: catalog with cover art, short + long descriptions, high-res press assets, factsheet-style metadata, trailers/downloads, and a simple contact/press page. Full press-kit tooling (presskit(), Press Kitty) is overkill for a single-owner catalog site but validates that per-game hi-res cover download and concise blurbs are expected baseline, not a differentiator.
